Create a golden-ratio triangle on a plane from an X interval

**Panel:** Comma → Util · **Nickname:** `GoldTri`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Plane | `P` | Plane | Item | `Plane.WorldXY` | Triangle base plane |
| X Size | `X` | Interval | Item | `new Interval(-1000, 1000)` | Dimensions of triangle in plane X direction. |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Triangle | `T` | Curve | Item | Triangle as a closed polyline |

## Right-click menu

Options in the component's context menu:

- Golden Triangle (36°)
- Golden Gnomon (108°)
